summary: A friendly running coach that takes first-timers from base miles to a confident half-marathon finish, one plan, one run, one split at a time.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.spec: There are three slides with bold run-type colour gradients. Slide 1 reads 'Your first half, coached' with a runner illustration. Slide 2, 'Pick your race and goal', shows the Lisbon Half on 14 Mar 2027 and a 2:05:00 goal picker. Slide 3, 'A plan that fits your week', has run-day toggles Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun. The primary action is a Build My Plan button that leads to today.

screens.name: Today
screens.spec: Greeting 'Bom dia, Maya' with a race countdown chip ('164 days to Lisbon Half'). The hero is a progress ring for this week: 1 of 4 runs and 5 of 25 km done, with four small day dots underneath, coloured by run type. Next comes today's workout card in the tempo colour: 'Tempo Run · 6 km', pace target 5:45/km, a warm-up/cool-down note and a big full-width Start button that opens live-run. Below sits a 'Coming up' list for Saturday's easy run and Sunday's long run, plus a coach tip card.

screens.name: Training Plan
screens.spec: The header shows the goal: 'Lisbon Half · 14 Mar 2027 · Goal 2:05:00'. Below it is an overall progress bar for the base block (week 3 of 10). Next comes a segmented control for Base and Race (16 wks). Each week is a collapsible card with its date range, total km and run chips coloured by type, each one ticked, today or upcoming. Past weeks show checkmarks, and Race weeks 1–16 start 23 Nov and build to a 19 km peak in week 13 before the taper. Tapping today's tempo chip opens live-run.

screens.name: Progress
screens.spec: The hero is a weekly distance bar chart covering the last 8 weeks, with this week partial. Two highlight cards follow: Longest Run (12.4 km, Sun 27 Sep) and Total This Year (412 km). Below them is an average-pace trend line chart falling from 6:52 to 6:18/km, with the goal-pace line at 5:55. The page ends with a Recent Runs list where each row is coloured by run type, and tapping a row opens run-summary.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: An avatar header shows Maya Ferreira, 32, Lisbon, with chips for her 9-run streak and level 'Base Builder'. Next is a Shoes section with mileage bars against a 700 km lifespan and an Add Shoe button. Settings rows cover units (km), the audio coach voice and cue interval, heart-rate strap, rest-day reminders, Apple Health sync and race goal, ending with Sign out.

screens.name: Live Run
screens.spec: The top half is a full-bleed map with the route traced in the tempo colour and a pulsing location dot. Below it, huge numbers show elapsed time 21:14 as the hero, with distance 3.68 km and current pace 5:41/km in large tiles beside it. A target-pace bar shows whether Maya is ahead or behind 5:45/km. At the bottom are a round Pause button and a long-press Finish button that opens run-summary.

screens.name: Run Summary
screens.spec: The top shows a route map card with a gold 'Personal Best · Fastest 5K 28:41' badge overlaid. A stat row follows: 6.02 km, 34:41, 5:46/km average, 162 bpm average and 412 kcal. Next is a splits-per-kilometre bar chart with six bars and the fastest split highlighted, then heart-rate zones as horizontal stacked bars Z1–Z5 with minutes. The primary action is a Save Run button, with a secondary Share option.
